always_shielded.gml: for (var n = 0; n < 120; n++) { var d = 1 + (n mod 12) * 0.12; var g = enemy_group("robots", d, false, false); var h = g[0]; if (car_shield_max(h) < 1) return false; } return true;

shield_fits_grid.gml: for (var n = 0; n < 120; n++) { var d = 1 + (n mod 12) * 0.12; var g = enemy_group("robots", d, false, false); var h = g[0]; if (h.gw != 3 || h.gh != 3) return false; var used = 0; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(h.facs); i++) used += array_length(h.facs[i].cells); if (used > 9) return false; } return true;

never_plated.gml: for (var n = 0; n < 120; n++) { var d = 1 + (n mod 12) * 0.12; var g = enemy_group("robots", d, false, false); for (var c = 0; c < array_length(g); c++) { if (car_armour(g[c]) != 0) return false; } } return true;

keeps_teeth.gml: var armed = 0; for (var n = 0; n < 120; n++) { var d = 1 + (n mod 12) * 0.12; var g = enemy_group("robots", d, false, false); var h = g[0]; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(h.facs); i++) { if (fac(h.facs[i].def).charge > 0) { armed += 1; break; } } } return armed;

power_balanced.gml: for (var n = 0; n < 120; n++) { var d = 1 + (n mod 12) * 0.12; var g = enemy_group("robots", d, false, false); var h = g[0]; if (car_power_use(h) > car_power_gen(h)) return false; } return true;

thinnest_hull.gml: var r = enemy_group("robots", 1.5, false, false)[0]; var c = enemy_group("corps", 1.5, false, false)[0]; var i = enemy_group("insects", 1.5, false, false)[0]; return (r.hull < c.hull && r.hull < i.hull);

hold_fire.gml: var pc = global.cb.player; pc.hull = 900; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(pc.facs); i++) { if (fac(pc.facs[i].def).charge > 0) pc.facs[i].hp = 0; } return true;

shield_eats.gml: var e = global.cb.enemies[0]; var before = e.shield_cur; e.shield_cur = max(0, e.shield_cur - 1); return (before > e.shield_cur);

drones_bare.gml: var e = global.cb.enemies; for (var i = 1; i < array_length(e); i++) { if (car_shield_max(e[i]) != 0) return false; } return true;
